{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the structure
sales.info()

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check the distribution of the target groups
total_new_paid_search = len(sales[(sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new')])
converted_new_paid_search = len(sales[(sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['converted'] == 1)])

# Compute conversion rate for new customers reached by paid search
conversion_rate = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search: {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted new customers reached by paid search: {converted_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
